content:
[Intro]
[Am]
[F]
[Dm]
[F]

[Verse 1]
[Am]Close my eyes
and drift into the
[F]silence
Barely see the ultra-
[Dm]violet
Slipped and fell into the
[F]deep end
[Am]Oh, the side-
walks shimmer just like
[F]diamonds
All the empty words were
[Dm]flying Well, the
heart was low but I
[F]never was alone
I
never was alone

[Chorus]
[Am]I've been
[C]running [Dm]for so
[F]long All that's
[Dm]left is skin and
[F]bones
[Dm]Close my eyes and
[F]fight to carry on
[Am]Sometimes it
[C]makes no [Dm]sense at
[F]all If I
[Dm]stumble, will I
[F]fall? If I
[Dm]fall I'll tuck and
[F]roll
Close my eyes and let the
love light guide me home
Let the
love light guide me home

[Verse 2]
[Am]Washed and fades
and falls into a-
[F]nother
I'm not getting any
[Dm]further
Left you feeling like an
[F]alien
[Am]All the shin-
ing sidewalks, they were
[F]lying
Lost myself while I was
[Dm]hiding And the
heart was low but I
[F]never was alone
I
never was alone

[Chorus]
[Am]I've been
[C]running [Dm]for so
[F]long All that's
[Dm]left is skin and
[F]bones
[Dm]Close my eyes and
[F]fight to carry on
[Am]Sometimes it
[C]makes no [Dm]sense at
[F]all If I
[Dm]stumble, will I
[F]fall? If I
[Dm]fall I'll tuck and
[F]roll
Close my eyes and let the
love light guide me home
Let the
love light guide me home

[Interlude]
[Am]
[F]
[Dm]
[F]

[Bridge]
[Dm]Hearts are empty
almost
[F]all the time
[Dm]Blind devising
ways to
[F]lead the blind
And it
[Dm]seems as if there's
no
[F]end in sight
[Dm]I don't wanna
be there when it all
[F]goes down
[Dm]But if I gotta
be there don't let me
[F]hit the ground 'Til I
hit the ground

[Chorus]
[Am]I've been
[C]running [Dm]for so
[F]long All that's
[Dm]left is skin and
[F]bones
[Dm]Close my eyes and
[F]fight to carry on
[Am]Sometimes it
[C]makes no [Dm]sense at
[F]all If I
[Dm]stumble, will I
[F]fall? If I
[Dm]fall I'll tuck and
[F]roll

[Outro]
[F]Close my eyes and let the
love light guide me home
Let the
love light guide me home
Let the
love light guide me home
title: Skin and Bones
